title: close-phase judges a landing by the phase the merge brings in
desiredOutcome: a phase signed off on its branch lands and is cleaned up in one close-phase run from the parent, its preview says the same, and a re-run never moves mergedAt

tasks.title: Fix BUG-8: close-phase judges cleanup by the phase as it stood before its own merge
tasks.description: Repro: sign off a phase in its linked worktree, then run close-phase.py <plan> <phase> --project <parent worktree> from the parent. Expected: the merge lands and the cleanup is judged against the phase as the merge left it (signed off and merged), so the worktree and branch are removed in one run. Actual: 'not done: phase P64 is pending, not done - sign-off has not passed'; a second run is needed, and it re-stamps mergedAt with its own time.

add: plugins/audit/tests/test_close_phase.py: repro that FAILS on current code - a phase signed off on its branch is refused cleanup as pending when landed from the parent
tools/check-git-pipeline.py: a worktree phase lands and is cleaned up in one run, and a re-run keeps mergedAt
